evidence.summary: Multiple clients share one resident generation and event cursor; stale cursors are explicit reset state.

reproduction.instructions: Run the resident Unix host, consume a cursor, restart the host, then request the old cursor; reconcile workspace_status before accepting new evidence.

summary: The event hub is bounded and correctly reports reset_required when a cursor ages out; the host does not yet persist cursor history across process restart.

workaround.description: Reconcile workspace_status and retain UNKNOWN until a client has a current event identity after restart.
